extension.summary: Callbacks for Kodi. Sends status to a UDP destination and/or the LoxBerry MQTT Gateway on player events (start, stop, pause, ...).
extension.description: Sends the following events via UDP and/or MQTT (LoxBerry MQTT Gateway): kodi_started, kodi_stopped, music_started, music_paused, music_resumed, music_stopped, movie_started, movie_paused, movie_resumed, movie_stopped, movie_title=%s, screensaver=on/off. Python 3 (Kodi 19 Matrix or later).
